pasos.altaResumen: Room types, rates and a batch of rooms in a four-step wizard.
pasos.altaDetalle: You declare once how long each stay lasts and what it costs. The board is built before the first guest walks in, without keying in one room at a time.
pasos.ocupacionResumen: Who checked in, how many they are and how long they have left, without opening anything.
pasos.ocupacionDetalle: Every card carries its own timer and progress bar. The front desk sees at a glance which stay is about to run out, instead of scanning a list of checkout times.
pasos.consumoResumen: Whatever is consumed goes on the room's folio and comes off inventory.
pasos.consumoDetalle: The folio lives next to the stay. Posting an order moves the stock ledger in the same operation, so the cash count matches the storeroom with nothing reconciled by hand.
pasos.rotacionResumen: On checkout, the room enters the housekeeping board on its own.
pasos.rotacionDetalle: Checkout raises the task, the task releases the room, and the metrics above move right then. Nobody has to tell anybody for turnover to keep going.

confianza.aislamientoTexto: The per-property filter lives in the data layer, not in every screen: a query that forgets it returns nothing, never someone else's rows.
confianza.rolesTexto: Every sensitive action declares the permission it needs. The front desk takes payment but never sees cost or margin; housekeeping works its own board and nothing else.
confianza.cajaTexto: Whoever closes the shift counts the drawer without seeing what the system expected.
confianza.bitacoraTexto: A wrong entry is corrected with another in the opposite direction, never by deleting.
